vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2297: Follow-up: auto-lower file-size baselines on UAT batch merge path

plan.title: Follow-up: auto-lower file-size baselines on UAT batch merge path
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: When UAT batch uat/pan-cobalt-0703 merged to main (PAN-2296), a baselined file shrank 1925->1924 lines but scripts/file-size-baseline.txt stayed at 1925, so `npm run lint:file-size` failed on main with a stale-high baseline. Root cause: mergeIntoMain() in src/lib/cloister/uat-promote.ts (lines 211-229, buildUatPromoteGitDeps) builds the batch merge in a throwaway worktree and pushes HEAD:main directly (merge at 222, push at 223) with NO baseline reconciliation between them. The only PAN-2227 guard is the .husky/pre-push hook, which is a check that would merely block (wedging a tested batch) and does not reliably fire on server-initiated automation pushes. A whole-tree grep confirms no code path invokes `lint-file-size.sh --update`; the auto-lower mode exists only as a manual CLI command.
narratives.Proposal: Enforce the invariant at the final write point, in code, independent of husky. In mergeIntoMain(), after `git merge --no-ff` and before `git push origin HEAD:main`, run `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh --update` in the merge worktree; if it lowered scripts/file-size-baseline.txt, `git add` it and `git commit --amend --no-edit` so main lands with a single merge commit = tested tree + baseline reconcile, then push. Lowering is audit-exempt (lint-ratchet-audit.sh gates only raises/adds), so no issue reference is needed on the amend. Extract the reconcile into an exported helper reconcileFileSizeBaseline(worktreePath, runGit) in a new module so it is unit-testable, and add a real-git integration test that reproduces PAN-2296 end-to-end.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT change the single-issue GitHub squash-merge path (feature-branch pre-push already forces a consistent tree before the PR is green).
- Do NOT modify .husky/pre-push or husky behavior.
- Do NOT auto-raise or auto-add baseline entries (raises stay manual and audited).
- Do NOT reconcile the eslint-any-allowlist.json ratchet (file-size only).
- Do NOT change UAT assembly (uat-assemble); the fix lives at the promote write point.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix at the promote's push-to-main write point (mergeIntoMain) rather than the pre-push hook or assembly.
autoDecisions.rationale: The write point is the last place the tree is guaranteed to be the exact bytes landing on main; a hook is a check that only blocks and does not reliably fire on server automation pushes.

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh --update` instead of re-implementing lowering.
autoDecisions.rationale: Single source of truth; the script already enforces lower-only/never-raise and drops obsolete entries.

autoDecisions.summary: Amend the merge commit rather than adding a second commit.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps main at one --no-ff merge commit per promote; baseline.txt is CI metadata, not tested behavior, so amending preserves the merge-what-you-tested contract with a documented exception.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract an exported reconcile helper despite it being single-use.
autoDecisions.rationale: The real mergeIntoMain closure is hard to isolate for tests; an exported helper makes the behavior provable in a unit test, consistent with the codebase's injected-deps testability convention.

items.title: Add reconcileFileSizeBaseline helper that auto-lowers and stages the baseline in a worktree

expected_outputs: file-size-reconcile.test.ts passes including a case that lowers a stale baseline and a no-op case

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/file-size-reconcile.ts exporting `async function reconcileFileSizeBaseline(worktreePath: string, runGit: (args: string[], cwd: string) => Promise<{ stdout: string }>): Promise<{ changed: boolean }>`. It runs `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh --update` with cwd = worktreePath (via execFileAsync on bash, or a small runShell using execFile — never execSync, per PAN-70). Then it checks `git status --porcelain -- scripts/file-size-baseline.txt` (via runGit, cwd = worktreePath): if the output is non-empty, run `git add scripts/file-size-baseline.txt` and return { changed: true }; otherwise return { changed: false } without staging. Do not commit here — committing/amending is the caller's responsibility (bead wire-into-promote). Add tests/unit/lib/cloister/file-size-reconcile.test.ts mirroring the temp-git-repo + installed-script pattern in tests/unit/scripts/lint-file-size.test.ts: (a) a baselined file shrunk below its entry -> helper lowers the entry, stages it, returns changed:true; (b) baseline already consistent -> returns changed:false and stages nothing.

items.title: Given a worktree whose baselined file is 1924 lines but scripts/file-size-baseline.txt records 1925, when reconcileFileSizeBaseline runs, then the entry is lowered to 1924 and the function returns { changed: true }.
Given changed:true, when the helper returns, then `git status --porcelain -- scripts/file-size-baseline.txt` shows the baseline staged (added to the index).
Given a worktree whose baseline already matches every file's line count, when reconcileFileSizeBaseline runs, then it returns { changed: false } and stages nothing (empty `git status --porcelain`).

Given a baseline entry whose file no longer exists (or is now at/under the 1000-line ceiling), when reconcileFileSizeBaseline runs, then that entry is dropped from scripts/file-size-baseline.txt and the function returns { changed: true }.
Reconcile the file-size baseline in mergeIntoMain before pushing the UAT batch to main

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/uat-promote.ts, inside buildUatPromoteGitDeps().mergeIntoMain (lines ~211-229), between `await runGit(['merge', '--no-ff', ref, '-m', message], worktreePath)` and `await runGit(['push', 'origin', 'HEAD:main'], worktreePath)`, call `const { changed } = await reconcileFileSizeBaseline(worktreePath, runGit)`. When `changed`, run `await runGit(['commit', '--amend', '--no-edit'], worktreePath)` so the lowered baseline becomes part of the single merge commit. Then push. When not changed, push the merge commit unchanged (no amend). Import reconcileFileSizeBaseline from './file-size-reconcile.js'. Update the file's top doc comment and/or the mergeIntoMain comment to record that main receives the tested tree PLUS a deliberate file-size-baseline reconciliation (baseline.txt is CI metadata, the only permitted deviation from the exercised tree).

items.title: Given a batch whose merged tree shrinks a baselined file below its entry, when mergeIntoMain runs, then reconcileFileSizeBaseline is invoked in the merge worktree before the `git push origin HEAD:main` call.

Given reconcile returned changed:true, when mergeIntoMain proceeds, then it runs `git commit --amend --no-edit` so the pushed main head is a single merge commit whose tree includes the lowered baseline.
Given reconcile returned changed:false, when mergeIntoMain proceeds, then it pushes the merge commit with no amend (the pushed tree equals the tested merged tree).
The mergeIntoMain / file-level doc comment states that the baseline reconciliation is a deliberate exception to 'main receives exactly the tree the operator exercised'.
Real-git integration test reproducing PAN-2296: batch shrink lands a consistent baseline on main

expected_outputs: a test that reproduces the PAN-2296 shrink-then-merge scenario fails before the wire-into-promote fix and passes after it

narrative.Action: Add tests/unit/lib/cloister/uat-promote-baseline.test.ts. Build a real bare origin repo plus a projectRoot clone containing scripts/lint-file-size.sh + scripts/file-size-baseline.txt (copy the real script like lint-file-size.test.ts does). Seed main with a baselined file at 1925 lines and a matching baseline entry. Create a uat/<name> branch whose tree shrinks that file to 1924 lines WITHOUT lowering the baseline (reproducing the PAN-2296 state). Call buildUatPromoteGitDeps(projectRoot).mergeIntoMain('uat/<name>', 'msg'). After it returns, fetch origin/main and assert: (a) the baselined file is 1924 lines; (b) scripts/file-size-baseline.txt records 1924 for that file; (c) running `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh` (check) against the origin/main tree exits 0. Keep git work in temp dirs; never touch the real repo. This test must fail against the pre-fix mergeIntoMain and pass after wire-into-promote.

items.title: Given a uat branch whose tree shrinks a baselined file from 1925 to 1924 lines with an un-lowered baseline, when mergeIntoMain promotes it, then origin/main's scripts/file-size-baseline.txt records 1924 for that file.
Given the promoted main tree, when `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh` (check mode) runs against it, then it exits 0 (no stale-high baseline).
Given the pre-fix mergeIntoMain (no reconcile), when the same scenario runs, then the test asserting a consistent baseline fails — proving the test reproduces PAN-2296.
